text.p: Typhoon Yates, with 140 mph winds, is centered near 17n/143e in the western Pacific, west of the Mariana Islands, moving west northwest at 10 mph. Yates will remain very powerful but may weaken slightly during the next 24-36 hours as it turns more to the north. Yates is an extreme threat to shipping.

Typhoon Zane is a strong risk to shipping during the next 24-36 hours as it moves from a position east-northeast of Luzon Philippines to southeast of Taiwan. Top winds are currently 105 mph but they may reach 130 mph in 36 hours. After 36 hours this most dangerous typhoon may threaten Taiwan or the southern Ryukyu islands of the East China Sea.

Hurricane Isidore is mainly a threat to shipping in the southern Atlantic. Top winds are currently 75 mph with the system about 725 miles west-southwest of the Cape Verde Islands. Winds may increase to about 90 mph in 48-72 hours.
